plans.note: Outline exposes only the preamble; the full MSA body is unsegmented within it. Scan the liability article for a cap amount, mutuality, and carve-outs (indemnity, confidentiality, IP infringement, gross negligence/willful misconduct) and check whether Kubient's cap is one-sided or excludes our recoveries.

Look for a Kubient indemnity covering third-party IP infringement and its own negligence/misconduct, plus any reciprocal AP indemnity that should stay narrow. Cross-check with the liability cap for a carve-out; do not double-flag the cap under LOL-CAP.

Presence rule: restrictions on AP's ability to operate competing businesses are uncommon in an ad-tech services MSA. Search the covenants/term sections for 'compete' or 'competing' before concluding it is absent.

Presence rule: check the services/scope and any inventory or supply provisions for exclusive-supply, 'sole provider' or preferred-partner language binding AP; flag only if AP's freedom to use other vendors is restricted.

Direction rule: scan pricing/fees for 'most favoured', 'no less favourable' or best-terms language. MFN running in AP's favour is acceptable and should not be flagged; only an AP-side obligation is a deviation.

Presence rule: check for a mutual or one-way non-solicit near confidentiality/personnel terms; assess duration, scope (employees actually engaged) and a general-advertising/unsolicited-response carve-out.

'Initial Term' is a defined term, so a term-and-termination article exists. Confirm AP has convenience termination on reasonable notice without penalty or acceleration, and that Kubient cannot terminate for convenience mid-term.
Tied to 'Initial Term': check for automatic renewal, the non-renewal notice window (prefer 30 days or less) and any renewal price uplift; a missing uplift cap is a rationale note, not a deviation.
Check the miscellaneous/general article for governing law and forum. New York is likely given both parties' offices; flag only foreign law/arbitration or a venue outside the accepted list.
In the general provisions, confirm AP may assign to affiliates and to a successor by merger or asset sale without consent, and that Kubient has no termination right on AP's change of control.

Direction rule: locate the intellectual property/data article and confirm AP retains ownership of AP content, data and any paid-for deliverables, with no assignment or broad licence-back to Kubient beyond what is needed to deliver the services.

Examine any licence grant to AP for the platform: it should extend to AP affiliates and contractors acting on our behalf and must not be revocable at will; note scope limits alongside the IP review without double-flagging ownership.

Check fees/compliance provisions for Kubient audit or inspection rights over AP usage or records; assess frequency, notice, on-site scope and who bears cost. Reporting obligations that run to AP are not an audit right.

Direction rule: look in fees/termination for early-termination fees, penalties or liquidated damages payable by AP; service credits or SLA remedies running to AP are favourable and should not be flagged.
Review the representations and warranties article for a services performance warranty, its duration and remedy (re-performance or refund), and whether an 'AS IS'/disclaimer swallows it.

Search for an insurance covenant (commercial general liability, tech E&O/cyber, workers' comp) with AP as additional insured or certificate delivery; if none exists anywhere, treat as missing since Kubient handles AP data.

Presence rule: check fees/order-form terms for minimum spend, take-or-pay, minimum impression volumes or shortfall true-ups binding AP, and whether an exit or termination right relieves the commitment.

In the effects-of-termination provisions, look for return or deletion of AP data in a usable format and transition/wind-down assistance; if only data deletion appears, note the gap in transition help.
